name: Cohen Woodworking
about:
Cohen Woodworking, an architectural woodworking firm, was founded in 1982 in St. James, Missouri, by the father of the current owners. Today the company is owned by two brothers and operates as a family-owned business serving clients nationwide.

The company specializes in standardizing and building high-quality custom millwork components and architectural casework. Its capabilities cover new construction, renovation, and disaster reconstruction projects, with a direct-to-vendor partnership model that manages projects from start to finish. Cohen has delivered projects in all 50 states, emphasizing on-time delivery regardless of location.

Cohen serves the healthcare, education, retail, transportation, and hospitality sectors, providing millwork for commercial projects across the United States. Its clients include general contractors and companies seeking a collaborative partner for custom woodwork in new builds, renovations, and post-disaster rebuilding.

The firm highlights its direct-to-vendor relationship model and a culture built on transparency, continuous improvement, tenacity, and accountability. Its stated mission is to work hard, treat people right, and strive for excellence, principles that have earned it AWI Quality Certification since 2008 and four AWI Awards of Excellence.

name: Coil Tec of Arizona Inc
old_description: Committed to producing the highest Quality magnetic components since 1989.
about:
Coil Tec of Arizona Inc operates from a 35,000-square-foot facility in Phoenix, Arizona. The company was founded in 1989 and has focused on magnetic components since its inception. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures transformers, inductors, and coils using cellular manufacturing techniques. Each production cell performs 100% testing of parts, and a quality team samples output under a zero-defect plan. The facility's layout and low overhead are cited as enabling competitive pricing.

Coil Tec serves customers requiring magnetic components, though specific industries or customer types are not detailed in its public materials. The company maintains a finished-goods inventory to support on-time delivery.

Coil Tec emphasizes its cellular manufacturing approach as a differentiator, claiming it provides the most predictable outcomes of any manufacturing method. The company also highlights its finished-goods inventory for on-time delivery and low overhead for competitive pricing.

name: Coldstream Power
old_description: Coldstream Power helps clients reduce their energy costs & carbon footprints.
about:
Coldstream Power is based in Milford, Ohio, and was founded in 2006. The company operates as a locally owned small business under the Coldstream Companies umbrella, which was started by Jon Davis. It began with a goal of helping homeowners in the Milford and greater Cincinnati area take control of their energy futures and find cost savings on utility bills while increasing sustainability.

The firm provides solar panel design and installation for both rooftop and ground-mounted systems, generator installation (primarily Generac units), EV charger installation compatible with any vehicle make, and electrical panel upgrades. Coldstream Power handles the full project lifecycle in-house — from consultation and custom design using modeling software to installation and activation — and notes that most solar installations are completed within one to two days. The team carries over two decades of combined experience in residential and commercial projects across the Cincinnati region.

Coldstream Power serves residential and commercial customers throughout greater Cincinnati, including communities such as Mason, West Chester, Blue Ash, and Morrow. Project examples cited on its site include a 5.6 kW system with REC400 panels in Miamisburg, a 10 kW system with Enphase batteries and microinverters in Milford, and a 53-panel array in Morrow.

The company emphasizes that it never uses subcontractors, relies on an in-house design team, and installs products from brands such as REC, Meyer Burger, Enphase, and Generac. Transparent pricing, free consultations, and flexible financing options — including $0-down solar — are presented as core differentiators, along with a commitment to honesty and customer satisfaction reflected in consistently high review ratings.

name: Cole Wire & Cable Co
old_description: A trusted distributor of high-quality wire and cable products since 1979, Cole Wire is a family-owned and operated company, built on our reputation for personalized service, fast turnaround, and a deep understanding of what keeps your projects moving.
about:
Cole Wire & Cable Co. is headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, with additional sales offices in Ohio. The company was founded in 1979 by Shel and Teri Cole and remains family-owned, now led by second-generation owner Leo Cole. Over more than four decades it has grown into one of the nation's largest master stocking distributors of specialty electrical and electronic wire and cable, serving customers across the United States and internationally in Canada, Mexico, the United Kingdom, and China.

The company operates a 26,000-square-foot combined office and warehouse that houses a multi-million-dollar inventory of products such as portable cord, tray cable, hook-up wire, armored cable, power cable, low-voltage wire, and electronic wire and cable. Beyond distribution, Cole Wire provides an extensive suite of in-house value-added services — cut-to-length, stripping, labeling, bundling, custom coloring, custom striping, custom printing, twisting, kitting, crimping, harness building, design/build/stocking programs, and re-spooling. It also runs a custom manufacturing division producing wire harnesses, cord sets, coil cords, and tailored assemblies for OEM, automotive, aerospace, and industrial applications, with scalable production from prototype to full-scale runs. All processes are backed by ISO 9001 certification.

Cole Wire serves a broad range of industries. Its OEM and manufacturing customers receive precise wire configurations bundled and stripped for fast, consistent builds. Construction and electrical contractors rely on custom-cut, labeled cable and stocked product ready to ship. Marine and offshore clients get rugged, corrosion-resistant cable for shipboard and facility use. Specialty contractors in remediation, pumps, conveyors, and high-temperature environments also source custom heavy-duty solutions. The company additionally supports automotive, aerospace, and general industrial sectors.

The firm's stated mission is to provide solutions that earn greater efficiencies for its customers. It emphasizes personalized service, technical expertise, and flexible customization — offering same-day shipping on stocked items, no cut charges, and full in-house control over quality and turnaround. This focus on reliability and service, shaped by integrity and responsive communication, is presented as the core differentiator.

name: Colorado Contract Cut & Sew
old_description: We die-cut for all types of fabric and foam as well as bias and straight cutting and binding.
about:
Colorado Contract Cut & Sew operates from Denver, Colorado, where it was founded in 1989 as a family-owned and operated contract cut-and-sew business. The company has remained under family ownership for over 35 years, building a reputation for reliability, quality, and collaborative service.

The facility provides die-cutting for all types of fabric and foam, bias and straight cutting, binding, and a range of sewing services including coverstitch, heat-seal label pressing, and automatic snap attachment. Equipment includes an Automatic Servo Cutting Table with Spreader, coverstitch machines with three needles, and modular die-cutting systems for label changes and clip tabs. The shop also offers pattern making, product design, prototyping, sample runs, and quick-turn short-run manufacturing without large minimum-order requirements.

The company serves diverse corporate markets, working with brands that need production-ready cut-and-sew components. While specific customer names are not disclosed, the service lineup indicates clients in apparel, soft goods, and labeled products requiring precision fabric and foam cutting.

Colorado Contract Cut & Sew emphasizes a collaborative process between its team and the customer, focusing on consistent quality, efficient production, and minimal material waste through automatic precision knife cutting technology.

name: Colorado Electric Corp
old_description: Providing Denver EV Charger Installations, Panel Upgrades, Service Calls, and New Home Wiring for Residential Clients
about:
Colorado Electric Corp is headquartered in Lakewood, Colorado, and was founded in 2006 by Dan, a licensed electrician with two decades of field experience. The company began as a local electrical contracting firm focused on residential service work and has since expanded across the Greater Denver metro area.

The firm specializes in high-impact electrical upgrades, including main panel upgrades and replacements, Level 2 EV charger installations, SPAN smart panel systems, and whole-building electrification. Its crews handle complete wiring for new construction, remodels, and dedicated equipment circuits for single-family homes, multi-dwelling units, and commercial buildings. With over 20 years of experience in West Denver and Jefferson County, the team provides end-to-end electrical scope from service calls to complex multi-unit installations.

Customers range from homeowners preparing for electrification to property managers of multi-family complexes and general contractors seeking a reliable electrical partner. The company also works closely with local plumbing and HVAC contractors who rely on its code-compliant connections for their own projects. Every technician sent to a job site holds an individual state license and insurance coverage.

Colorado Electric Corp distinguishes itself through a set of operating principles: no upselling, a commitment to getting the job right the first time, and transparent, upfront estimates often provided by phone or photo review. As a SPAN Certified Installer, the team helps clients access utility rebates and federal tax incentives for qualifying upgrades. All installations are backed by a three-year workmanship warranty, reflecting the founder’s emphasis on clear communication and lasting craftsmanship.

name: Colorado Industrial Packaging
old_description: We take pride in working to understand our customers specific needs, and designing and delivering solutions that meet packaging, cost, and time requirements. Colorado Industrial Packaging specializes in high-quality box packaging design in Denver, Aurora and Colorado Springs, CO, creating functional and visually appealing solutions tailored to your needs.
about:
Colorado Industrial Packaging operates from Aurora, Colorado, serving the state’s Front Range and surrounding communities. The company does not disclose its founding year or original founders in its public materials, and no ownership designation such as family‑, veteran‑, or woman‑owned is stated. It positions itself as a packaging corporation and design company focused on durability, branding, and cost‑efficiency for businesses across the region.

CIP manufactures custom packaging solutions including corrugated boxes, foam inserts, and wood crates, supported by a short‑run manufacturing line that allows lower startup costs and reduced minimum orders. The company maintains an in‑house engineering and design team that follows a 7‑Step Design Process for applications ranging from fighter‑jet seats to semiconductor equipment. It also stocks more than 15,000 packaging supply items—boxes, foam, bubble wrap, mailers, tape, labels, stretch wrap, and strapping—with free shipping and delivery offered on stock orders.

The company serves a diverse industrial base: aerospace and defense (including fighter‑jet seating), semiconductor equipment manufacturers, medical device makers, electronics producers, and general manufacturing. It also supports retail, e‑commerce, food and beverage, and pharmaceutical businesses that require custom branded boxes, protective packaging, or retail‑ready presentation.

CIP emphasizes speed and flexibility, claiming up to three times faster turnaround than competitors thanks to its short‑run capabilities. A 30‑day upgrade promise guarantees cost‑effective designs without sacrificing quality, while engineering expertise helps clients reduce material usage and adopt eco‑friendly alternatives. The firm highlights personalized, relationally‑driven service and a consultative approach that begins with a free packaging consultation.

name: Colorado Microcircuits
old_description: By automating every step of the IC assembly process we work to increase reliability and drive costs down.
about:
Colorado Microcircuits operates a custom-built facility in Loveland, Colorado. The company, known as CMI, specializes in highly automated contract assembly of microwave and RF semiconductors. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public materials.

CMI provides assembly of single and multi-die components using off-the-shelf or custom packages, including ceramic, air cavity lead frames, overmold lead frames, and high-performance laminates. Its processes cover die attach, wire bonding, mixed assembly of integrated circuits and surface-mount components, high thermal conductivity epoxies, short/tuned/stacked wires, stacked die, and GGI flip chip. The company reports manufacturing volumes ranging from thousands to millions of units, leveraging industry-standard automated semiconductor assembly equipment in an ISO 9001 compliant environment.

The company serves the RF and microwave semiconductor market, describing itself as a key assembly partner for industry leaders in that sector. It targets customers needing an onshore U.S. partner for commercial volumes and competitive pricing, emphasizing proximity to any U.S. customer.

CMI states its niche is innovative air cavity packaging, and that automating every step of the IC assembly process increases reliability and drives down costs. It aims to provide turnkey solutions with short production lead times, and positions its high-volume onshore capability as a way to mitigate geopolitical supply chain risks.

name: Colorado Mountain Solar
old_description: At Colorado Mountain Solar, we believe that making the switch to solar should be simple, honest, and rewarding. We strive to empower our customers by providing sustainable, reliable, innovative, and personalized solar energy solutions for energy independence, while supporting the environment and contributing to our community.
about:
Colorado Mountain Solar is based in Buena Vista, Colorado, where it provides solar energy solutions for residential and commercial customers. The company focuses on making the switch to solar simple, honest, and rewarding.

The company designs, installs, upgrades, services, and maintains both grid-tied and off-grid solar systems, including roof-mounted and ground-mounted configurations. It incorporates battery storage and backup generators where needed, and offers system upgrades such as additional panels, new inverters, expanded battery storage, and updated monitoring. A System Care Program provides preventive maintenance, system optimization, and priority service, while pre-purchase inspections deliver a Solar System Health Report for property buyers.

Colorado Mountain Solar serves homeowners, business owners, and off-grid property owners across residential, commercial, and off-grid solar markets. It also supports real estate transactions with pre-purchase inspections. A customer testimonial from Stewart Legg describes rapid emergency repair for an off-grid system.

The company says it differentiates itself through customer-focused service, honest guidance, top-quality products, expert craftsmanship, and support that lasts long after installation. Its stated values are empowerment, sustainability, and excellence, and it commits to responding to estimate requests within two business days.
